hero.head: Training,
hero.lead: {{sessions}} workouts grounded in the literature (Seiler, Daniels, Billat, Coggan), {{plans}} pre-built plans from 5K to marathon, {{calculators}} calculators and a route generator. Everything runs in your browser — no data ever leaves your device.

s01.title: One tool per use, not per persona.
s01.body: Zoned doesn't ask who you are — it lets you choose how to approach the work.
s01.e1Body: Filter by discipline, zone, duration, level. Every card states its difficulty and TSS cost before you click. Today's pick adapts to your recent load.
s01.e2Body: From 5K to marathon, 8 to 18 weeks. Transparent load progression, recovery week every 21 days, taper calibrated for race day.
s01.e3Body: Every session cites its method (Seiler, Daniels, Billat, Coggan), the physiological adaptation targeted, the zone, and a verifiable bibliographic reference.

s02.title: Three sessions to stay on the right volume.
s02.body: Deterministic by ISO week — no A/B, no engagement loop. Click to adjust the criteria.

s03.body: Every session in the library is anchored in this system. Your personal ranges are computed from your tests (HRmax, FTP, threshold pace, CSS).

s04.title: Four schools, one library.
s04.body: Zoned does not push a single method. Every session declares its school and reference — you remain free to mix them.
s04.schoolSeilerDesc: Split weekly volume into two poles: ~80 % below the first threshold, ~20 % above the second. The middle — the 'grey zone' — is kept to a minimum.
s04.schoolSeilerBib: Seiler, Sportscience 13 (2009) · Stöggl & Sperlich, Front. Physiol. 5 (2014)
s04.schoolDanielsDesc: Five precise paces (E, M, T, I, R) derived from a VDOT value computed from a recent race. A prescription logic of unusual pedagogical clarity.
s04.schoolBillatDesc: Very short intervals at the minimum velocity at VO₂max, alternating 30 s effort / 30 s recovery. Maximises time at VO₂max without excessive debt.
s04.schoolBillatBib: Billat et al., Med. Sci. Sports Exerc. 33 (2001)
s04.schoolCogganDesc: Quantify training load through the intensity (IF) and duration (TSS) pair. Provides a common vocabulary across cyclists, runners and triathletes.
s04.schoolCogganBib: Allen, Coggan & McGregor, Training and Racing with a Power Meter (3rd ed., 2019)
s04.quote: "Endurance is not a mystery. It is physiology patiently stacked week after week, plus a little patience."

s06.title: A toolkit to measure your ranges.
s06.body: Every computation runs in the browser, no data is sent. Formulas are documented and the source code is readable.

s08.body: Zoned is built to run entirely locally. No analytics server, no account, no password to remember, no third-party cookies. The code is public and auditable under AGPL-3.0.
